analysis.title: PrimeView (lite): Risk On in Hyperscalers and Software Post Midterm Results
key_insights: Hedge funds focused on long buying in Hyperscalers and Software after the midterm results, while flows in Power and Neoclouds were muted despite the prior day's sharp sell-off. UBS PB Book flows were consistent with the risk-on price action.

Hyperscalers were the most bought segment of US equities on 11/4 (+1.1std), driven by 100% long buying. Hedge funds had de-risked the names into earnings and the midterms, with high volatility in flows.
Software & SaaS was strongly bought (+1.6std), with 93% of flows from long buying, concentrated in AI Software names. This continues September's net buying (covering plus long buying).
Hardware (-0.4std) and Memory (-0.3std) remained net sold. Both segments have been de-risked since May, when hedge fund de-grossing began ahead of the summer unwind.
Rate Cut Winners were net bought +2.5std, driven by 73% long buying.
Hedge funds covered shorts and bought long in US Staples through October ahead of the midterms with a Democratic win priced, leaving them well positioned for the bounce.
US Power fell -6.3% and Neoclouds fell -8.4% on 11/4, but hedge fund flows in both were muted. UBS suggests the selling came from elsewhere, potentially macro funds.
Semis fell -3.2% with muted hedge fund flows. Hedge funds had already cut Semis exposure significantly in October, back to July lows, leaving less exposure to unwind.
Materials was the clearest profit-taking pocket (-3.2std), with long selling concentrated in Specialty Chemicals (-1.5std).

In Europe, the Ex-AI basket was the most bought, in line with broadening price action into laggards. High Momentum (+1.7std) and Low Quality (+2.2std) saw the strongest net buying, with over 70% from long buying and about 30% from covering.
European Luxury saw +2.2std of covering, its strongest net buying day YTD. Consumer Discretionary saw +1.5std of covering.
High Quality and Energy exposure in Europe continued to unravel as the market priced US/Iran closer to a resolution, a trend since mid-October. Hedge funds have also been adding shorts in EU Energy.

UBS Equity Strategy recommends buying Semis and Hyperscalers. The Semis case cites a smoother pace of data-centre buildout given the Democratic win, expected buybacks, intact underlying demand and multi-year-low valuations, against light positioning.
